name: Applied Machine Learning for EV Diagnostics and Prognostics
description: EV introduction, types of failure in EV, fundamentals of EV diagnostics and prognostics, sensors, signal processing, feature engineering, fault diagnosis - classification models, prognostics and health management (PHM), importance of PHM in EVs, machine learning-based prognostic models, remaining useful life (RUL) prediction - regression models, bayesian approaches for RUL prediction, uncertainty management, sensor and model fusion, case studies on EV system and components, future trends in EV diagnostics and prognostics.
